title: Node depends-on Technologyservice
description: A node (a workload or compose service) depends on a technology service it connects to; it cannot run correctly when that service is unavailable. This is the consumer side, distinct from technology.technologyservice depends-on technology.node, where the service depends on the node that hosts it.
x-dr-evidence: A Kubernetes Deployment or docker-compose service whose environment, config or code addresses another Service by name (DATABASE_URL=postgres://db:5432, http://payments-svc); CBM CONNECTS_TO.
